name: Lysander Quill
description: Spectacles on a ribbon, ink on every finger. Reads the spines while he waits.

visits.greeting: A scholar's request, curator, and a dull one, I promise.

request.text: On Keeping. For my monograph on the history of preservation charms. Footnotes, mostly.

readThoughts.default: Pages forty to sixty. The Ollery bequest.

purpose.1: A history of keeping charms. The Ollery estate collected them. So, it seems, did your library.

lent.line: Splendid. I'll return it annotated. Lightly.

alternative.line: Not the volume I wanted, but scholarship is patient.

declined.line: A pity. The footnotes will suffer.
